tagline: Find the place that farms your field's future.
pitch_opening: Every team here will tell a farmer what to plant next year. We are telling them where their farm is going, and who already farms there.

reveal.headline_example: Your field in 2045 is Central Thailand today.
reveal.subline: That place exists. People farm it now. Here are the crops suited to its climate.

honesty_panel.title: Side by side: your field in 2045 vs its twin today
honesty_panel.intro: Eight numbers, all computed from NASA POWER data. Closer numbers mean a better match.

drift.title: Your field has already moved
drift.template: In climate terms, your field's twin has drifted {drift_km} km since 1995.
drift.example: In climate terms, your field's twin has drifted 610 km since 1995.
drift.subline: This is the backtest. It shows our method describes real, measured change, not a forecast.

transition.title: How long will today's crop hold?
transition.subline: Viability of the field's current crop, scored every five years.

crops_there.title: Crops suited to {twin_place}'s climate
crops_there.subline: Crops suited to the twin's climate, with their tolerance sources.

buttons.pick_field: Pick a field on the map

tooltips.gdd: Growing degree days: accumulated warmth above 10C. Higher means a crop reaches maturity faster.
tooltips.wet_share: How concentrated rainfall is in the wet season. Same total rain, very different farming.
tooltips.dry_spell_days: The longest run of dry days in a year. Often the single number that decides if a crop survives.
tooltips.heat_days: Days hotter than 35C. Heat during flowering causes rice and maize to fail to set grain.
tooltips.solar: Average sunlight energy reaching the ground. Sets the ceiling on photosynthesis.
tooltips.match_score: How closely the twin matches your field's 2045 signature. 1.0 would be a perfect match.
tooltips.distance_km: Straight-line distance from your field to its climate twin.

caveats.title: What this tool does and does not do
items: NASA POWER is gridded climate data at roughly 50 km, not a measurement of this specific field.
We do not forecast weather, yield, or profit.
A linear trend is a simplifying assumption, not a climate projection.
Confirm any planting decision with a local agricultural adviser.

data_credit: Climate data: NASA POWER. Crop tolerances: FAO ECOCROP.
ai_disclosure: Built with Kiro, Amazon's AI coding tool, as disclosed under NASA Space Apps rules.
